failure_replay_retention: episode_records holds one compact record per episode (seed, role schedule, outcome, steps, regret, calibration, leakage), which is the replay depth available in a run with no model calls.

unavailable_metrics.persuasion_delta: Discussion uses a deterministic template renderer with no LLM listener, so no persuasive effect can be measured.
unavailable_metrics.strategy_diversity: Requires an embedding or paraphrase model; not implemented in v0.
unavailable_metrics.runtime_and_token_cost: No model calls are made in this run, so token cost is not applicable. Wall-clock runtime is recorded in execution.wall_clock_seconds.
unavailable_metrics.strict_identical_observations: Once variants choose different actions their trajectories diverge, so identical observations across variants cannot hold beyond the first divergence. Initial role schedules are shared and verified instead.
unavailable_metrics.vote_target_evidence: textarena 0.7.4 strips role tags from PLAYER_ACTION messages, so vote targets are unobservable and no vote evidence metric exists.

non_discriminating_metrics.mean_action_regret_by_kind.mafia_elimina: Structurally zero for every variant: the Mafia's legal night targets already exclude its own team, so the truth oracle scores every legal choice faction-optimal. This metric cannot separate variants in SecretMafia and is reported only for completeness.

reading_notes: Every seat is driven by the same policy, so win rates are self-play outcomes and are zero-sum across factions; they are descriptive, not the quality claim.
The quality claim rests on calibration, correct evidence updating, action regret and leakage, in that order, as the task's quality standard requires.
mean_brier_village_side is null for plain and memory because those variants keep no belief at all; it is unavailable, not zero.
self_play_win_rate_focal_seat_mixed_roles follows seat 0, whose role varies by seed, so it mixes factions. Read village_faction_win_rate and per_role instead.

belief_discrimination.interpretation: flat_fraction is the share of decisions where every legal target had the same marginal Mafia probability, so the belief could not rank them and the tie-break alone decided the action.
